name: Are my files uploaded when adding page numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Page numbering is processed entirely in your browser. Files never leave your device.

name: Can I customise the format of page numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can choose position (top/bottom, left/center/right), font size, starting number, and prefix/suffix text.

name: Can I skip the first page (cover page) when numbering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can set the starting page and choose which pages to number.
No. PDFree has no page or file size limits.
